title: More Than a Milestone: The Meaning of Graco's Quarter Century Club

## More Than a Milestone: The Meaning of Graco's Quarter Century Club


As Graco celebrates more than a century of innovation and growth, another milestone continues to highlight what makes the company unique: its people.


For nearly 50 years, Graco's Quarter Century Club (QCC) has recognized employees who have dedicated at least 25 years of service to the company. In today's workforce, where long-term tenure is increasingly rare, the club stands as a testament to the commitment, expertise and loyalty from those that have helped shape Graco's success for generations.


Today, the Quarter Century Club includes more than 800 members, made up of both current employees and retirees who have helped support the company throughout its history.


#### A tradition that began in 1977


The first Quarter Century Club banquet was held in 1977 at Minneapolis' historic Jax Café, located near Graco's headquarters at the time. The event started a tradition that is still seen today, one that honors the employees whose dedication and contributions helped build the company.


As membership to the club continued to grow, the banquet eventually outgrew its original venue and moved to something bigger.


*Members of the Quarter Century Club reminisce in 1980.*


The club continues to welcome new members each year across its global locations and subsidiaries. On average, around 26 employees join the club annually, a trend that speaks to the longevity that remains a staple of Graco's culture.


#### A reason to come together


The celebration has become an important tradition for many members. Each year, Quarter Century Club members gather for a banquet that celebrates their service, achievements and shared memories. The event provides the opportunity for longtime colleagues and retirees to reconnect, reflect on their time at Graco and learn more about the latest company developments. It is also a time to recognize the newest inductees of the club.


*Graco employees inducted into the Quarter Century Club in 2026.*


#### Recognizing the people behind Graco's success


Graco's longevity is built on more than its innovative products and technology. It is also built on the dedication, knowledge and experience of the employees who have committed decades of their careers to the company.


The expertise of longtime employees helps foster collaboration, mentorship and new ideas and continuous improvement across the organization. Their contributions have played an important role in supporting the innovation and growth that helps Graco grow and move forward.


The Quarter Century Club is just one example of how Graco recognizes and celebrates the commitment of its employees. For nearly five decades, the club has honored the individuals whose loyalty and service have helped shape the company's legacy and build the foundation that Graco will build upon for its future initiatives.
